entities.summary: Final Independence & Peace of Westphalia, a transformative movement in Netherlands (1621–1648). Emerged from Peace of Westphalia and Assassination of William the Silent. Catalyzed Frederick Henry and Peace of Westphalia recognises Dutch independence.
